rules.P01-ENUM-SCOPE: Ordinary ontology_mapping.evidence[].evidence_type uses EvidenceTypeEnum. MANUAL_CURATION explicitly claims evidence supplied by a human reviewer. ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum.MANUAL_CURATION is separate and is excluded from this audit.
rules.P02-EXACT-BASELINE: Compare the complete evidence object with every baseline mapping-evidence object. Full-value equality, not source/name equality, establishes inherited_unchanged.
rules.P03-AUTHOR-CHAIN: A new entry is agent-authored when its exact proposal/before-after history and linked case author/reviewer scope identify the campaign agent work. llm_assisted is supporting metadata only, never the sole proof.
rules.P04-MIXED-JUDGMENT: For a proven agent-authored source-applicability, identity, formulation, property or alias judgment, LLM_SUGGESTION is a conservative native type. A supplier URL, ontology URL, publication author or user-contributed dataset is not proof of a MIM human reviewer.
rules.P05-DIRECT-DATABASE: DATABASE_MATCH may describe an actual direct ontology match when the full narrow assertion is established by an inspected successful term response. Do not invent DIRECT_ONTOLOGY_MATCH or treat every ontology citation as this type.
rules.P06-HISTORICAL-AMBIGUITY: A new agent wrapper around an inherited assertion does not establish authorship of the underlying historical evidence. Keep ambiguous and do not force a type without actual human/process lineage.
rules.P07-NO-SCIENTIFIC-RENEWAL: Provenance and type suggestions do not approve chemical identity, mappings, sources, quantities, owner merges, selectors, exports or release. W02 entries receive mechanical/provenance-only diagnosis because of earlier authorship.
rules.P08-SEPARATE-AXES: Leave EvidenceSourceEnum, mapping_quality, ComponentEvidenceTypeEnum and scientific validity untouched. An ontology term createdBy a human does not mean that human supplied this MIM evidence entry.
rules.P09-CONDITIONAL-NARROWING: Where a narrower evidence method is plausible but the complete current entry combines a database fact with source applicability or interpretation, retain a conditional alternative rather than converting automatically.
